title: Polynomial from its coefficients
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number and let $p\in\mathbb F_2[X]$ have natural degree less than $\ell$. The polynomial formed from its coefficients in degrees $0$ through $\ell-1$ is equal to $p$.
